shortDescription: Manage user accounts and user attributes on a BIG-IP

options.name: partition
options.description: Device partition to manage resources on.

options.name: partition_access
options.description: Specifies the administrative partition to which the user has access. C(partition_access) is required when creating a new account, and should be in the form "partition:role". Valid roles include C(acceleration-policy-editor), C(admin), C(application-editor), C(auditor), C(certificate-manager), C(guest), C(irule-manager), C(manager), C(no-access), C(operator), C(resource-admin), C(user-manager), C(web-application-security-administrator), and C(web-application-security-editor). options.name: password_credential
options.description: Set the user's password to this unencrypted value. C(password_credential) is required when creating a new account.

options.name: provider
options.description: A dict object containing connection details.

options.name: state
options.description: Whether the account should exist or not, taking action if the state is different from what is stated.

options.name: update_password
options.description: C(always) allows the user to update passwords. C(on_create) only sets the password for newly created users. When C(username_credential) is C(root), this value is forced to C(always).

options.name: username_credential
options.description: Name of the user to create, remove, or modify. The C(root) user may not be removed.
